name: RE-Agent
description: RE-Agent (LXC) is the static-analysis variant of the RE-Agent appliance. Agentic reverse-engineering and malware-analysis workstation: Hermes Agent with the REA MCP server registered, Ghidra headless, OpenBin BINNY, CAPA, FLOSS, YARA, Detect It Easy, Radare2 and UPX, plus rea-case for evidence-backed case folders, re-firewall to restrict egress to an allowlist of LLM hosts, and a local memory store (holographic) with optional embeddings.

notes.text: The LXC shares the Proxmox host kernel. Use it for static analysis only, and run or detonate samples in the RE-Agent VM.
Run 're-agent-setup' inside the guest to configure your model provider and start the Hermes gateway API on port 8642 (key in /home/analyst/.hermes/.env).
The Hermes dashboard listens on 127.0.0.1:9119. Reach it with: ssh -L 9119:127.0.0.1:9119 root@<IP>
Run 'rea-case new <sample>' to start a case in /work/cases.

Run 're-firewall isolate local' as root before handling samples (or 'isolate <proxy_ip> [port]' to use a proxy on the host). Only allowlisted LLM hosts stay reachable, IPv6 is blocked, and it persists across reboots.

Add a custom OpenAI-compatible provider with 're-agent-config provider add <name> <base_url>' (for example heretek https://llm.heretek.one/v1), and turn on memory search by meaning with 're-agent-config embeddings <base_url> <model>'. Both add the host to the egress allowlist.
After setup, take a clean baseline snapshot: pct snapshot <ctid> baseline-clean
